nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io.sge_backend.sge_qvtpy_array_resources(backend: str, *, include_eicab: bool = False, eicab_device: str = 'cpu', eicab_pe_smp: int | None = None) → tuple[nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources, bool]¶

Padded resources for a per-subject qvtpy array job.

Uses qvtpy project/account/queue. When include_eicab is true, bumps h_vmem / ngpu / pe_smp / use_nv so the shared request covers the eICAB task.

Returns (resources, use_nv).
